mechanics.claim: Galio steps back over the cast time, then dashes to the target location until he hits an enemy champion or terrain.
mechanics.quote: '''Galio''' {{tip|lunge|steps back}} in the opposite direction over the cast time, then {{tip|dash|dashes}} to the target location until he hits an enemy {{tip|champion}} or [[terrain]].

mechanics.claim: Damage is dealt to all enemies passed through during the dash, reduced to 80% against non-champions (e.g. the dummy).
mechanics.quote: deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies he passes through, reduced to 80% against non-champions

mechanics.claim: Galio will initiate the dash even if his step backwards is interrupted by a knockdown.
mechanics.quote: '''Galio''' will initiate the {{tip|dash}} even if his step backwards is {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}}.
